title: WAF Console · CrowdSec
subtitle: CrowdSec LAPI on loopback · fail-closed · CRS OOB log-only · admin network only
search_hint: Map country selection filters all tabs.
dash.alerts_24h: LAPI alerts in the last 24 h
map.note: Robinson map of LAPI alert coordinates. No third-party GeoIP.
ga.note: GA4 sessions are real-user volume by country and host. LAPI/GA density separates scanner-heavy countries from user-impact risk. Map coordinates stay CrowdSec LAPI.
ga.title: GA4 precision
ga.inactive: GA snapshot not loaded — LAPI only. Console never sends traffic to Google.
ga.unconfigured: Drop an aggregate GA4 snapshot JSON at WAF_GA_SNAPSHOT_FILE to raise finding precision. Do not call the Google Data API from this console. Do not add gtag to /waf.
th.name: Name
sites.hint: Per-FQDN AppSec filters (allow path, skip in-band rule, host bypass). Keep gRPC/OIDC hosts out of scope. CRS in-band, fail-closed and INCLUDE_LARGE_UPLOADS are not controllable here.
policy.name: Name
policy.skip: Disable in-band rule on this host
policy.bypass: Bypass AppSec for the whole host
policy.path: Path prefix (required for allow; optional for skip)
policy.confirm: I confirm bypass_host (AppSec will stop blocking this FQDN)
policy.hint: Create / edit / delete AppSec policies. Apply sends SIGHUP to the CrowdSec engine (does not restart the orchestrator). If AppSec fails, the previous YAML is restored.
policy.empty: No operator policies — default+vpatch+CRS OOB applies to every in-scope Host
decisions.title: Local decisions
decisions.hint: Only crowdsec/cscli origins. The CAPI community blocklist is omitted. Unban by IP still deletes the LAPI decision. Fail-closed and CRS OOB stay unchanged.
alerts.title: Recent alerts
rules.policy_hint: The UI never enables CRS in-band, INCLUDE_LARGE_UPLOADS or fail-closed changes.
allow.title: Allowlists and operators
allow.note: LAPI /v1/allowlists plus optional parser file. Writing allowlists requires cscli on the CrowdSec host.
engine.p1: LAPI and AppSec listen on 127.0.0.1 only
engine.p3: CRS out-of-band: detect/log, do not ban
engine.p4: This console does not go through the CrowdSec bouncer (anti-lockout)
engine.p6: No orchestrator restart · no CRS in-band · no INCLUDE_LARGE_UPLOADS · no bot challenge
engine.p7: Map uses LAPI geo only · Hub rules are read-only
engine.p8: Mutations that change fail-closed/CRS in-band: none (forbidden in the UI)
engine.p9: Operator control: per-site policies, CIDR allowlist, IP ban/unban
engine.p10: OWASP Top 10:2021 correlation is local; CTI connectors export files only (no outbound push)
owasp.title: OWASP Top 10:2021
owasp.hint: CrowdSec LAPI/AppSec findings mapped to OWASP Top 10:2021. Local enrichment only. File export to MISP, TheHive, OpenCTI STIX — no outbound push.
mitre.title: MITRE ATT&CK
mitre.local: Local ATT&CK Enterprise catalog. No MITRE GitHub download at runtime.
mitre.filter_hint: Click a tactic or technique tile to filter findings. Map country selection filters all tabs.
mitre.open: Open the MITRE tab for full ATT&CK correlation.
